$meta.name: Apple Design Language tokens
$meta.author: Edison Augustin X.
$meta.verifiedAgainst: Apple Human Interface Guidelines, content current through September 2026
$meta.usage: Reference values for design, mockups, validation, and web adaptation. In native apps, ALWAYS use the system API listed in `api` — Apple states documented values may change between releases.

color.note: visionOS uses the default dark values for system colors. Apple does not publish values for semantic colors (label, systemBackground, separator…); use their APIs.

ios.note: iOS and iPadOS Dynamic Type sizes, including larger accessibility sizes AX1–AX5.

watchos.note: watchOS Dynamic Type sizes, including larger accessibility sizes AX1–AX3.

macos.note: macOS doesn't support Dynamic Type; values are line height.
